text: Yes - as Nansi says, this has not been a requirement since 2024: aic.org.il/2024-big-updates-to-partner-visa-procedures-5-2-0008-5-2-0009/ People from countries that do register foreign marriages should do it to save the hassle at the end of the process. But since you are from a place which doesn't, there should be no need to provide this - if the clerk is ignorant of the change, you should refer them to the procedure :)
